hero.title: Trezor Cuts Its Resellers After Ledger Finds Spy Implant in Crypto Wallets
hero.description: Trezor is ending reseller authorizations on January 1, 2027, after Ledger confirmed that wallets sold by a Southeast Asian retailer carried a hidden implant that sent out users' recovery phrases.
